title: Precious Ponies
description: Two Eriskay ponies embrace each other in Eriskay, Scotland. The ponies are an endangered, ancient breed native to the Outer Hebrides islands of western Scotland. With around 400 remaining, they are known for their fine gray coat that develops as they age. The people of Eriskay care for the ponies as they roam the village, and the Eriskay Pony Society has been working with the Rare Breeds Survival Trust to bolster the population of pure Eriskay ponies.
translated_description: 在苏格兰埃里斯凯岛上，两匹埃里斯凯小马相互依偎。这种小马是苏格兰西部外赫布里底群岛特有的古老品种，目前处于濒危状态。现存约400匹，它们以随年龄增长而呈现的精致灰色皮毛著称。当小马们在村庄中漫步时，埃里斯凯岛民悉心照料着它们。埃里斯凯小马协会正与珍稀品种生存信托组织合作，致力于增加纯种埃里斯凯小马的数量。
